name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefit: ₹6,000/year in 3 instalments directly to bank account
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable landholding

name: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi NREGA)
benefit: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per year per household. HP wage rate: ₹266/day (2025)
eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work

name: Ayushman Bharat – PM-JAY
nameHi: आयुष्मान भारत – पीएम जन आरोग्य योजना
benefit: ₹5 lakh/year health insurance for secondary & tertiary care
eligibility: Families listed in SECC-2011 data; BPL families

name: Him Care Yojana
benefit: ₹5 lakh/year health coverage for HP residents not covered under Ayushman Bharat
eligibility: Himachal Pradesh domicile, not covered under PM-JAY

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
benefit: ₹1.30 lakh financial assistance for pucca house construction
eligibility: Houseless and kutcha house dwellers in rural areas, BPL

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
benefit: Education support, awareness campaigns, scholarship for girl child
eligibility: Families with girl children, especially in districts with low sex ratio

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: High-interest savings scheme (8.2% p.a.) for girl child education & marriage
eligibility: Girl child below 10 years; account by parents/guardians

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: Free LPG connection to BPL households
eligibility: Women from BPL households not having LPG connection

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
benefit: Scholarships from ₹1,000 to ₹20,000/year for pre-matric to post-matric students
eligibility: SC/ST/OBC/Minority students; income below specified limit

name: HP Medha Protsahan Yojana
benefit: Up to ₹1 lakh coaching assistance for competitive exams (UPSC, IIT, Medical)
eligibility: HP domicile students, income below ₹2.5 lakh/year, 10+2 passed

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Short-term credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest (effective 0% with Govt. interest subvention) for farming needs
eligibility: All farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit: Crop insurance against natural calamities, pests, diseases at very low premium
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

name: Mukhyamantri Swavalamban Yojana (HP)
benefit: 25-35% capital subsidy on projects up to ₹60 lakh for youth entrepreneurs
eligibility: HP domicile youth aged 18-45 years for starting new enterprise

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan)
benefit: Collateral-free working capital loan: ₹10k → ₹20k → ₹50k with credit score building
eligibility: Street vendors who were vending before March 24, 2020

name: Old Age Pension (NSAP/IGNOAPS)
benefit: Central: ₹200–₹500/month. HP State top-up: ₹1,500/month (age 60–69) and ₹1,750/month (age 70+). Apply at Panchayat office.
eligibility: Age 60+ years, BPL household, HP domicile
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development + HP Social Justice Dept.

name: Widow Pension (IGNWPS)
benefit: Central: ₹300–₹500/month. HP State top-up brings total to ₹1,500/month. Apply at Gram Panchayat office.
eligibility: Widow aged 40–79 years from BPL household, HP domicile
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development + HP Social Justice Dept.

name: Sahara Yojana (HP)
benefit: ₹3,000/month financial assistance for patients suffering from serious illnesses requiring long-term care
eligibility: HP domicile; suffering from cancer, Parkinson's, muscular dystrophy, hemophilia, thalassemia, renal failure, or liver failure. Income below ₹4 lakh/year.

name: Mukhyamantri Grihini Suvidha Yojana (HP)
benefit: Free LPG gas connection with first cylinder and stove to BPL families in HP not covered under PM Ujjwala Yojana
eligibility: HP domicile BPL family; woman of the household must not already have an LPG connection
ministry: HP Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department

name: National Food Security Act (PDS / Ration Card)
benefit: BPL families: 35 kg food grains/month at ₹2/kg (rice) and ₹1/kg (wheat). AAY (Antyodaya) families get highest priority.
eligibility: Families listed under SECC-2011 or identified by state as BPL/AAY. HP domicile required for HP ration card.
ministry: HP Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department

name: Jan Manch (HP Grievance Platform)
benefit: On-the-spot resolution of public grievances by senior government officers at the village level. No office visits needed.
eligibility: Any resident of Himachal Pradesh with a pending govt. service complaint or grievance

name: Disability Pension (IGNDPS)
benefit: Central: ₹300/month. HP State top-up brings total to ₹1,500/month for persons with 80%+ disability.
eligibility: Age 18–79 years, 80% or more disability certified by Govt. doctor, BPL household, HP domicile
documents: Disability Certificate (80%+ from Govt. Medical Board)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development + HP Social Justice Dept.
